name: Rusoro Mining Ltd.
summary: Rusoro Mining Ltd. engages in the acquisition, exploration, development, and operation of gold mining and mineral properties in Venezuela. The company primarily holds 95% interest in the Choco 10 mine; and 50% interest in the Isidora mine. The company was formerly known as Newton Ventures Inc. and changed its name to Rusoro Mining Ltd. in November 2006. Rusoro Mining Ltd. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
